label: Smart Classroom
info:
Team 1 - Smart Classroom Energy Management (Laptop 1 / server).

Reference architecture stages:
(1) IoT node -> (2) MQTT broker -> (3) this flow: validate -> (4) SQLite + Dashboard 2.0 -> (5) ML service (Python, via MQTT) -> (6) Decision engine (this flow) -> (7) MQTT control -> (8) actuator node acknowledges.

All thresholds are in the CONFIG node. Broker credentials come from the environment variables SC_SERVER_USERNAME / SC_SERVER_PASSWORD (loaded from ../.env by settings.js).

sql: INSERT INTO commands (command_id, room_id, load, cmd, reason, data_ts, sent_at, sent_at_ms, telemetry_sent_at_ms, status, ack_state, ack_received_at, roundtrip_ms, loop_latency_ms) VALUES ($id, $room, $load, $cmd, $reason, $data_ts, $sent_at, $sent_ms, $tel_ms, $status, $state, $at, $rtt, $loop) ON CONFLICT(command_id) DO UPDATE SET status = excluded.status, ack_state = excluded.ack_state, ack_received_at = excluded.ack_received_at, roundtrip_ms = excluded.roundtrip_ms, loop_latency_ms = excluded.loop_latency_ms

Model comparison: latest training run in SQLite model_metrics (written by train_models.py)

sql: SELECT model, category, MAX(CASE WHEN split='validation' AND metric='f1' THEN round(value,3) END) AS val_f1, MAX(CASE WHEN split='test' AND metric='f1' THEN round(value,3) END) AS test_f1, MAX(CASE WHEN split='test' AND metric='precision' THEN round(value,3) END) AS test_precision, MAX(CASE WHEN split='test' AND metric='recall' THEN round(value,3) END) AS test_recall, MAX(CASE WHEN split='cv' AND metric='f1_mean' THEN round(value,3) END) AS cv_f1_mean, MAX(CASE WHEN split='cv' AND metric='f1_std' THEN round(value,3) END) AS cv_f1_std, MAX(CASE WHEN split='compute' AND metric='median_ms' THEN round(value,2) END) AS latency_ms, MAX(run_id) AS run_id FROM model_metrics WHERE task='occupancy' AND run_id = (SELECT run_id FROM model_metrics WHERE task='occupancy' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY model ORDER BY val_f1 DESC
